platformBar.label: Control plane: platform administration
platformBar.title: Control plane
platformBar.text: Quant Ticaret platform administration. Not a shop's panel.

signIn.title: Sign in to the control plane
signIn.subtitle: Sign in with your platform staff account.
signIn.noAccount: No account? Ask the platform owner for an invitation.

code.title: Two-step verification
code.subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
code.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved at setup; each works once.
code.wrong: The code is wrong or already used; enter the app's current code.
code.expired: This sign-in step ran out. Choose another account and sign in again.

intro.promise: Run every shop and every customer from one place.

shops.title: Shops
shops.text: Open a new shop by entering its details; follow the others with their term and state.

access.title: Staff and roles
access.text: Owner, operations, finance and viewer roles; every sensitive change verified again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.text: Every change, refusals included, recorded with who made it.

security.title: Two-step verification, always
security.text: No switch to turn it off; every sign-in asks the app's code.

intro.footer: For Quant Ticaret platform staff only.

app.title: Set up two-step verification
app.text: Two-step verification is required in the control plane. Scan the code below with an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password.

codes.title: Keep your recovery codes
codes.text: Without your phone you can sign in with one of these codes. They will not be shown again.

done.title: Setup complete
done.text: For your security, sign out and sign in again with your password and the app's code.

enrol.qr: QR code for the authenticator app
enrol.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter this key in the app:
enrol.passwordHint: Your password is asked too, so only the account's owner can set this up.
enrol.kept: I have saved the codes somewhere safe

linkRequired.title: Setup link required
linkRequired.text: Your two-step verification was reset. Open the setup from the link in your email; without one, ask the platform owner for a new link.

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.text: This setup link is incomplete or damaged. Open the link in the email again or ask the platform owner for a new one.

codes.label: Recovery codes
codes.hint: Each code works once. New codes make the old ones invalid.

invite.title: Accept the invitation
invite.subtitle: {{email}} is invited with the {{role}} role. Choose your name and password; two-step verification comes next.
invite.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters. Do not reuse a password from elsewhere.
invite.passwordShort: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.

invalid.title: Invalid invitation
invalid.text: This invitation link is incomplete or damaged. Open the link in the email again or ask the platform owner for a new invitation.

roleText.owner: Everything: staff, closing shops, keys and the audit log.
roleText.operator: Opening and setting up shops, notes, packages and overrides.

common.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it by hand.

stepUp.title: Verify it is you
stepUp.text: Enter the code from your authenticator app for this change. The verification holds for five minutes.
stepUp.failed: The code is wrong or already used; try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: As shops open, active shops, monthly revenue, late payments and health will show here.

account.title: My account
account.text: Your name, two-step verification and open sessions.

profile.title: Profile
profile.text: Your name shows in the audit log and the staff list.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.text: Always on in the control plane; it cannot be turned off.
mfa.codesText: The old codes no longer work. These will not be shown again.
mfa.newPhoneTitle: Move verification to a new phone
mfa.newPhoneText: The current verification is turned off and your other sessions end. You set it up again on the new phone right after; until then nothing else in the control plane opens.
mfa.newPhoneConfirm: Turn off and set up again

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.text: Your open sessions in the control plane. End one you do not recognise.

staff.title: Staff
staff.text: The platform staff who use the control plane, and their roles.
staff.invitesText: Invitations not yet accepted. A withdrawn invitation's link stops working.

invite.title: Invite staff
invite.text: The invitation goes by email. The owner role is never given by invitation; give it to an existing member later.

member.yourself: You cannot change your own role or access.

deactivate.title: Deactivate the member
deactivate.text: {{name}} can no longer sign in; their open sessions end at once. Their account and history stay.

reactivate.title: Reactivate the member
reactivate.text: {{name}} comes back with their old role and signs in again with their password and the app's code.

reset.title: Reset two-step verification
reset.text: Verification is turned off for {{name}} and every session of theirs ends. A single-use link to set it up again is sent; it holds for 24 hours.

invite.title: Invitation ready
invite.mailed: The invitation was sent by email.
invite.byHand: No email could be sent. Pass the link on through a safe channel; it is not shown again once this closes.
invite.expiry: The invitation expires and works once; send a new one if it runs out.

enrol.title: Verification reset
enrol.mailed: The setup link was sent by email.
enrol.byHand: No email could be sent. Pass the link on through a safe channel; it is not shown again once this closes.
enrol.expiry: The link holds for 24 hours and works once.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.text: Every change in the control plane, refusals included, and sensitive reads. Entries cannot be changed.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.text: Your account is not active in the control plane: it may be deactivated, or its verification setup window ran out. Talk to the platform owner.

errors.generic: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
errors.unreachable: The control plane's server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

status.400: What was sent is not valid; check the fields.
status.401: Your session ended. Sign in again.
status.403: You are not allowed to do this.
status.409: The record changed meanwhile; reload and try again.
status.429: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.

api.csrf_rejected: The request did not come from this page and was refused. Reload and try again.
api.invalid_request: The request is not valid; reload and try again.
api.too_many_requests: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.

cp.audit_kind_invalid: The entry kind is not valid.
cp.challenge_unknown: The sign-in step ran out; sign in again.
cp.email_invalid: The email address is not valid.
cp.enrolment_token_invalid: The setup link is invalid or expired. Ask the platform owner for a new one.
cp.invite_failed: The invitation could not be made. Try again in a moment.
cp.invite_invalid: The invitation is invalid or expired. Ask the platform owner for a new one.
cp.invite_login: The invitation cannot be accepted with this account. Open the link again.
cp.invite_member: This address already has an account.
cp.invite_pending: This address has an open invitation; withdraw it first.
cp.last_owner: The last active owner cannot lose the role or access. Make another member an owner first.
cp.mfa_code_invalid: The code is wrong; enter the app's current code.
cp.mfa_code_used: That code was just used; wait for the app's next code.
cp.mfa_not_started: The setup has not started; reload and try again.
cp.mfa_start_failed: The setup could not start. Try again.
cp.name_invalid: The name holds characters that are not allowed.
cp.name_required: First and last name are required.
cp.no_role: Your account is not active in the control plane.
cp.not_staff: This account is not platform staff.
cp.owner_exists: The platform has an active owner; this invitation no longer works.
cp.register_closed: An account is made only with a valid invitation, for the invited address.
cp.reset_self: Renew your own verification from My account.
cp.session_required: Your session ended. Sign in again.
cp.session_revoked: Your session was ended. Sign in again.
cp.session_unknown: The session was not found; it may have ended already.
cp.sign_in_locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a while and try again.
cp.step_up_failed: The code is wrong or already used.
cp.step_up_invalid: The verification ran out; verify again.
cp.step_up_locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a while and try again.
cp.step_up_required: Verify it is you for this change.
